QuestInfo.name: [Operation: Dive] Parallel Magatia
QuestInfo.0: This Magatia is somewhat different than the other Magatias you've visited. You should look around for now.
QuestInfo.1: The chimeras are supposed to be kept in the underground labs... What are they doing roaming the streets? First thing's first, you'll have to defeat them.
QuestInfo.2: You heard a familiar voice. Better see what they have to say...
